Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['Thus, we will want to transfer all right of beneficiary to you so auto enable you make claims of the funds on our behalf because I am not properly disposed due to my present situation.', "I want you to stand for me as a proxy person that's my late father's foreign business partner so an s to get the fund out of the bank and to transfer it to your bank account in your country where we can make use of it in lucrative business investment in your country.", 'If you decide to render your service to us in this regard, 20% of the total sum will be offered to you.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
